name: Ford - Parts Redistribution Center, Brownstown Township MI

fieldNotes.truckGate: Continuous chain-link perimeter fence rings the property (confirmed in 2024 Street View along Inkster Rd). Single controlled entry via a long ~600m private access road from Pennsylvania Rd to the north.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Access road is private - Street View does not go down it. A small structure is visible near the building-end yard entrance but cannot be confirmed as a staffed guard booth. Flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Gate present; no confirmed booth - set true at low confidence.
fieldNotes.preGateStaging: The long private access road and its widenings provide ample off-road truck waiting space before the yard.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Dock doors with trailers backed in along the north and south building faces; ~90 estimated -> 50+ band.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Very large organized trailer-storage yards on the north and south sides - well over 200 trailers visible -> 50+ band.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Two dedicated trailer-storage lots (north and south yards) packed with parked trailers.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock banks on physically separate north and south building faces.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail line passes well east of the property; no spur enters the site - not rail-served.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-township site surrounded by woods, open fields and low-density residential; isolated industrial setting -> Rural.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide private access road and large paved yard aprons leave clear room for an express lane.
fieldNotes.trailerParkingCapacity: Capacity is a high-confidence-range overhead estimate from the dense trailer rows.
